title: Quantifying Algorithmic Biases over Time
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focuses on quantifying temporal variations in gender bias within algorithmic image search results.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as its case study focuses exclusively on gender bias.
